patients.csv.grain: One row per patient before deliberate quality issues.

columns.gender: Female, Male, Other; some missing values injected.
columns.insurance_type: Government, Private, Employer, Self-pay; some missing values injected.

admissions.csv.grain: One row per hospital admission; deliberate duplicate rows are appended.

columns.patient_id: Foreign key to patients.patient_id; a few orphan values injected.
columns.discharge_date: Discharge date; some invalid date ordering injected.
columns.department: Hospital department; inconsistent labels deliberately injected.
columns.bed_type: General, ICU, Observation; some missing values injected.
columns.length_of_stay: LOS in days; some negative values injected.

readmissions.csv.grain: One row per generated 30-day readmission event.

columns.original_admission_id: Foreign key to admissions.admission_id; some orphan values injected.
columns.days_since_discharge: Days after discharge; mostly 1-30, with some >30 dirty values.

staffing.csv.grain: One row per date × department × shift.

columns.staff_count: Staff on shift; some zero values injected.
columns.patient_count: Patients handled/on census; some missing values injected.

costs.csv.grain: One row per admission before deliberate orphan rows.

columns.insurance_covered_amount: Amount covered by payer; some missing values injected.
columns.out_of_pocket: Patient responsibility; some impossible values injected.
